_about: Per-model reader profiles for annual-report reading (2026-10-13, Shivam: every worker calls each model per its profile). Read by ingest_annual_reports.py at start; edit and restart the worker to apply. prompt: plain = PROMPT (version ar-v1), exhaustive = PROMPT + ar_queue.EXHAUSTIVE (version ar-v1x). piece_chars: the worker's piece size (one per worker: pieces are cut per report before a reader is chosen). rpm/tpm/rpd: free-tier limits per key (Google AI Studio dashboard 2026-10-13; null = not published, paced by slots and 429 handling). slots: requests in flight per key. A reader at its rpd rests until Google's reset (PT midnight). Test evidence: tasks/ar_study/READER_FINDINGS.md. Zen models are listed in zen_models.json (passed register) and take their prompt from here.
